crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “I am Yahweh. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”
Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.”
Afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said to Pharaoh, “This is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Let my people go…
For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people. You have not rescued your…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”
translations.bsb: “Go and tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites go out of his land.”
